image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured beige carpet. The bib is primarily white with light blue trim and features a pattern of green cartoon animals (possibly frogs or bears) and text elements. It has a rounded shield shape with a curved neck opening and white fabric ties at the back.

Characters appear melted or nonsensical (e.g., 'PQF' or similar gibberish), which is a common AI artifact where text generation fails to produce coherent typography.

The green ink/pattern appears slightly 'smudged' or fused with the underlying fabric weave rather than sitting crisply on top. The edges of the green shapes lack sharp definition, suggesting minor generative blur or texture bleeding.
